description:
Scan the vault for Tasks-plugin-style markdown task lines (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) and filter by status, priority, due date range, recurrence, or tag. Result items include the task text, source file, line number, status, and parsed metadata — enough to locate and further manipulate each task via `tasks.toggle` or `tasks.updateMetadata`. `sortBy` controls ordering; `limit` caps the result count. Read-only. For vault-wide counts without per-task detail, use `tasks.stats`.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

dueAfter.description: Only tasks due strictly after this ISO date.

dueBefore.description: Only tasks due strictly before this ISO date.

dueWithinDays.description: Only tasks due within N days of today (inclusive).

limit.description: Cap the number of results. Default: 500.

sortBy.description: Result ordering. Default: file then lineNumber.

tag.description: Only tasks that carry this tag (leading `#` stripped).

name: tasks.search

outputSchema.description: Standard list envelope used by list/search tools.

items.description: List of result items; per-item shape depends on the tool.
Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.

title: Search Tasks
